'''2001 Ryloth Cup Challenge''' was a Star Wars CCG cup series (3 legs) held in Netherlands in November 2001. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] won it. It is known from Bastian Winkelhaus's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3114">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ the-circle-is-now-complete], DeckTech (Bastian "Death Star" Winkelhaus, 23 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-23-the-circle-is-now-completed3114/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' November 2001
* '''Site:''' Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
